name: statement-extract
description: Deterministic, reconcile-gated extraction of bank and card statements (QFX/OFX, CSV and PDF for TD, CIBC, Scotiabank, Tangerine, Desjardins, BMO, Wise) into canonical, masked, deduplicated JSONL, plus loan and mortgage balance snapshots (TD, CIBC, BMO, NSLSC) as opt-in position records: fail-closed exit codes, frozen transaction keys, an OTel-shaped run log. Stdlib Python only.
